heading: Grant authorization
lead: The Attorney General shall award grants to States and units of local government in accordance with this subchapter.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 3797j of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2002—Pub. L. 107–273 inserted “and units of local government” after “States”.

ancestors.heading: PAUL COVERDELL FORENSIC SCIENCES IMPROVEMENT GRANTS
